definition: A correction cycle is an observed failing acceptance/verification, diagnosis, change and affected rerun; superseded cancellations and deliberately red controls are not product failures. Review hardening is listed separately.

cycles.failure: Current registry contract assumed quoted object keys; blessing/welcome/kitchen are unquoted
cycles.fix: Anchored quoted-or-unquoted current registry assertion, unchanged exactly-once requirement
cycles.after: contract PASS: 9 products, 4 collections, 256 translation keys; all full runs

cycles.failure: route.fetch request context disposed during image request teardown (17/21 PASS)
cycles.fix: Drain active guarded route handlers before context.close; abort new teardown requests; retain browser.newPage ownership

cycles.failure: Product navigation checked empty selection before inquiry.js finished (20/21 PASS)
cycles.fix: Wait for exact inquiry URL and document load before the same ID assertion

cycles.failure: Intentional timeout was correctly red/124 but had zero PNG evidence
cycles.fix: Own SIGTERM capture, pre-wait synthetic screenshot; negative-control-only budget 15s; normal suite budget unchanged

cycles.failure: New dispatch-only diagnostics workflow was not registered before default-branch integration (404)
cycles.fix: Scoped push registration, diagnostic job still manual-only

cycles.failure: Raw summary annotation truncated by GitHub 4 KiB limit; JSON decode failed
cycles.fix: Lossless gzip/base64 chunks <=2800 chars with completeness checks and roundtrip unit test
cycles.after: Complete original failed and passing full summaries recovered through Checks API

Explicit installed Chromium override only for local smoke; actual CI proves clean pinned Playwright Chromium provisioning
